svt_mipi_dsi_dual_err_check Class Reference

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Derived sampling and checking class used by svt_mipi_dsi_dual_monitor to register usage checks implemented as part of the transactor. The object detect class is handed a check/coverage manager in it's constructor. If this is not null, the object detect class will instantiate this class, which in turn, will register the checks associated with the object detection code.

Member Function Documentation

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_err_check::new
 (  string instance_name , svt_mipi_dsi_dual_agent_configuration cfg , bit register_default_chks = 1, bit enable_default_chks = 1, bit enable_pass_cov = 0, bit enable_fail_cov = 1  ) 

CONSTUCTOR: Create a new svt_mipi_dsi_dual_err_check instance.

instance_name - Used to indicate which instance the messages are from.

cfg - Dual DSI agent configuration class handle.

register_default_chks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/ checking class should be automatically registered.

enable_default_chks - A bit that identifies whether or not the default checks associated with this sampling/ checking class should be enabled. This bit only has meaning if register_default_checks is set to 1.

enable_pass_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the PASS checks coverage should be enabled.

enable_fail_cov - A bit that identifies whether or not the FAIL checks coverage should be enabled.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_dual_err_check::register_default_checks
 (  bit enable_checks = 1  ) 

This method is called by the constructor if the register_default_checks parameter is set to 1.

enable_checks - Bit that identifies whether or not the checks that are registered by this function should be enabled or disabled.
